title: Make paper with me - Cottage Vlog
en: salutations welcome to the cottage fairy today i will be making my own paper and wanted to give you some insight into the process it's quite simple slow and meditative a beautiful way to reuse paper scraps and consequently reduce waste learning new crafts is very important to me i'm always trying out new ideas and projects working with your hands in order to create something either useful or beautiful is always so exciting in the case of paper making i create

something that is both traditional and nature-based crafts hold a special place in my heart in a world where fast fashion is mainstream where you often only find factory made products on store shelves becoming an artisan changes you as a consumer it gives you insight into the process of creating forming a story behind the end result
i find my home feels far more meaningful filled with things that i have created myself learning new crafts brings me joy
because it teaches me patience acquiring a skill takes time and whatever you create is made more meaningful because you created it do
do with each attempt i will become more skilled the results more sophisticated and my efforts rewarded but all this takes patience in the meantime i enjoy the excitement of learning do

so closed captioning sometimes my projects don't work out like i imagined there is something that goes straight into the compost but that's why i started this channel to embrace the process of creating no matter the result i wanted to share my passion for making beauty or trying to make beauty in

alignment with nature be it through art or crafts cooking or simply living my dream i am an artist and consequently like to make artistic videos through lovely images of my home i want to send out peaceful thoughts and hope and faith that anything is possible and that life can be if you choose full of joy and meaning so

do after a long day i find no greater gift of care you can give yourself than a homemade meal i struggle to have thoughtful sit-down meals and using my own vegetables and herbs motivates me to slow down focus on my senses and truly appreciate
the gift of an abundant harvest you
zh: 向小屋仙女致意，今天我将制作自​​己的纸张，并希望让您深入了解这个过程，它非常简单，缓慢且冥想，是一种重复使用纸屑并从而减少浪费的美丽方式，学习新工艺对我来说非常重要，我总是尝试新的想法和项目，用你的双手来创造一些有用或美丽的东西，在我创造的纸张制作中总是如此令人兴奋
在快时尚成为主流的世界里，传统和自然工艺品在我心中占有特殊的地位，你经常只能在商店货架上找到工厂制造的产品，成为一名工匠改变了你作为消费者，它让你深入了解创造的过程，在最终结果背后形成一个故事
我发现我的家感觉更有意义，充满了我自己创造的东西，学习新工艺品给我带来快乐
因为它教会我耐心，获得一项技能需要时间，无论你创造什么，都会变得更有意义，因为你创造了它
每次尝试我都会变得更加熟练，结果会更加复杂，我的努力会得到回报，但所有这一切都需要耐心，同时我享受学习的兴奋
所以隐藏式字幕有时我的项目并不像我想象的那样有一些东西直接进入堆肥，但这就是为什么我开始这个频道来拥抱创造的过程，无论结果如何我想分享我对创造美丽或试图创造美丽的热情
与自然保持一致，无论是通过艺术或手工艺烹饪还是只是实现我的梦想我是一名艺术家，因此喜欢通过我家的可爱图像制作艺术视频我想传达和平的想法、希望和信念，一切皆有可能，如果你选择充满欢乐和意义，生活就可以成为这样
经过漫长的一天后，我发现没有什么比自制的饭菜更能照顾自己了，我很难坐下来吃周到的饭菜，而使用自己的蔬菜和香草促使我放慢对感官的关注，并真正欣赏
